shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: Ogow sugitaanka ka hor intaadan gelin.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Madax bannaan, kuma xirna Uber Eats, Deliveroo ama Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Warbixin dhow ma jirto? PickupRadar wuxuu muujin karaa {likelyFast} ama {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): wakhtiga sugitaanka qaadista ee darawalada gaarsiinta Boqortooyada Ingiriiska

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Ka hor intaadan gelin, eeg inta ay darawaladu ku sugaan maqaayadaha iyo dukaamada. Darawalada Uber Eats, Deliveroo iyo Just Eat ee Boqortooyada Ingiriiska. Diiwaangelin looma baahna.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Ogow sugitaanka ka hor intaadan gelin.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Ma u gaarsiisaa Uber Eats, Deliveroo ama Just Eat? Eeg sugitaanka qaadista ee dhow ee maqaayadaha iyo dukaamada. Ka fogow sugitaan dheer. Taabo {reportWait} oo hel {radarPoints}. Diiwaangelin looma baahna.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Hadda waxay ku taal Milton Keynes. Xigta waa London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: App-yada iPhone iyo Android ayaa dhowaan imaanaya.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Tusaale shaashadda Home ee PickupRadar oo tab {nearby} furan, meelaha qaadista midab ayaa loo kala saaray sugitaanka

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Shaashad tusaale: sugitaan tijaabo ah, ma aha warbixin toos ah oo darawal

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Shaashad tusaale. Kuwani waa wakhti sugitaan tijaabo ah, ma aha warbixin toos ah. {live} xog dhab ah.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Isticmaal {nearby} si aad u hesho meelaha qaadista ee kuu dhow marka goobtu shidan tahay. Isticmaal {fast} iyo {slow} si aad u eegto sugitaanka iyo qiyaasaha.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Isku day magac, aag ama sumad boosto, sida KFC ama Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Shaashadda {reportWait} ayaa furmaysa. Dooro wakhti sugitaan. Waxba lama diro.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in
home.signals.title.text: Waxa aad arki karto ka hor intaadan gelin

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Calaamadahaas ayaad ku arkaa app-ka. Darawalada ayaa sheega, ma aha app-yada gaarsiinta.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Darawaladu waxay doortaan wakhti sugitaan. Waxaad arkaa sugida hadda iyo inta darawal ee ku sheegay 2 saacadood ee u dambeeyay.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Waxaa la muujiyaa oo keliya marka warbixin dhow aanay jirin. Kuwani waa qiyaas, ma aha warbixin toos ah.

home.signals.closed.pill.text: Dhowaan ayaa la sheegay inuu xiran yahay

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Darawaladu waxay taabtaan {reportProblem} si ay u sheegaan. Warbixinta waxaad arkaa ka hor intaadan u kaxayn.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Meelo qaadis oo maqan ama qaldan

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Saddex tallaabo oo fudud. Warbixintu waxay qaadataa ilbiriqsiyo.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Eray sir ma jiro. App-ku wuxuu si toos ah ku siinayaa astaanta Radar. Uma baahnid inaad is diiwaangeliso.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Hel meesha qaadista. Eeg sugida hadda, ama {likelyFast} ama {likelySlow} haddii warbixin dhow aanay jirin.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Kadib markaad qaadato dalabka, taabo {reportWait}. Waxay qaadataa ilbiriqsiyo. Warbixintaadu waxay caawisaa darawalada kale, waxaadna helaysaa {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Meel qaadis oo u qalanta oo kuu dhow, sugitaan dhow lahayn, {likelyFast} ama {likelySlow} lahayn. Warbixinta waxaad ku heshaa 15 RP halkii 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Kuwani waa magaalooyinka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ee app-ka. Ma helayso magaaladaada? Ka codso app-ka. Ama taabo {notify} magaalo {comingSoon}. Waxaan kuu soo diraynaa iimayl markay furnaato.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar waa madax bannaan. Kama mid aha Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat ama app gaarsiineed kale. Waligiis ma isticmaalo xisaabaadkaaga halkaas.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Waligeen ma weydiino magaca isticmaalaha ama erayga sirta ah ee Uber Eats, Deliveroo ama Just Eat.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Xogta macmiilka ama dalabka ma jirto.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Magacyo, cinwaanno ama nambar dalab ma jiraan.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Maya. App-ku wuxuu si toos ah ku siinayaa astaanta Radar. Sugitaanka isla markiiba waad sheegi kartaa. Si aad u ilaaliso {radarPoints}, iimaylka dib u dar. Eray sir looma baahna. App-ku wuxuu kuu soo diraa koodh 6 lambar ah iimayl ahaan.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: App-yada iPhone iyo Android ayaa dhowaan imaanaya. Hadda, {preview} wuxuu muujiyaa meelo qaadis iyo sugitaan dhab ah oo Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Dabagalka gadaal ma jiro. App-ku wuxuu isticmaalaa goobtaada intaad isticmaalayso, si uu u muujiyo meelaha qaadista ee dhow oo uu u hubiyo inaad joogto meel qaadis markaad warbixinayso. Goobtu waxay weydiisaa goobta oo keliya markaad doorato inaad isticmaasho. Akhri {privacy} si aad u ogaato wax dheeraad ah.

app.meta.title.text: Horudhac toos ah oo app — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Tijaabi app-ka PickupRadar xog dhab ah oo Milton Keynes. Hareera eeg, raadi meelaha qaadista oo arag shaashadda warbixinta.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Kani waa PickupRadar oo leh xog dhab ah oo Milton Keynes. Hareera eeg. Raadi meel qaadis oo fur. Waxa aad halkan taabato lama diro. Warbixin waxaad ku samayn kartaa oo keliya app-ka mobaylka.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Horudhac buuxa oo app PickupRadar ah oo leh xog dhab ah oo Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Caawimaad PickupRadar: la xiriir taageerada, ka warran dhibaato meel qaadis, oo ka hel jawaabo astaanta Radar, {radarPoints} iyo tirtirka xisaabta.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Caawimaad ma u baahan tahay? Noo soo dir iimayl ku saabsan app-ka, meel qaadis, {radarPoints} ama asturnaantaada.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Noo soo dir iimayl caawimaad, fikrado, dhibaatooyinka meelaha qaadista ama su'aalaha asturnaanta:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Warqadaha oo keliya. Iimaylku waa dariiqa ugu dhakhsaha badan ee aad noogu soo gaari karto.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Haddii aad dhibaato sheegto, noo sheeg:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Aagga ama sumadda boostada, haddii aad taqaan

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Nooca telefoonka, haddii app-ku dhibaato leeyahay

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: App-ku wuxuu si toos ah ku siinayaa astaanta Radar. Uma baahnid inaad gasho si aad u isticmaasho PickupRadar ama aad u hesho {radarPoints}. Ku darista iimaylka waa ikhtiyaar. Waxay ilaalisaa {radarPoints} haddii aad bedesho ama aad dib u dejiso telefoonka. Eray sir looma baahna. App-ku wuxuu kuu soo diraa koodh 6 lambar ah iimayl ahaan.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Waxaad helaysaa {radarPoints} warbixinada sugitaanka ee saxda ah ({waitRp}, ama {neededRp} markay tiraahdo {reportNeeded}), abaalmarinta warbixinta koowaad ({firstRp}) iyo meelaha qaadista aan oggolaano ({approvedRp}). Darawal waxaad ka casuumi kartaa {profile}. Labadiinnuba waxaad u baahan tihiin xisaabo Radar oo la ilaaliyay (ku dar iimaylka). Saaxiibkaa wuxuu geliyaa koodhkaaga ka hor warbixinta sugitaanka ee saxda ah ee koowaad. Marka saaxiibkaa sameeyo 3 warbixin oo sugitaan sax ah, ugu yaraan 2 maalmood oo kala duwan (waqtiga UTC), 2 meelood oo qaadis ah oo kala duwan, midkiin ba wuxuu helaa {referralRp}. {rewards} Weli ma beddeli kartid {radarPoints}.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} waxay leedahay {messages}: ogeysiisyo, digniino iyo fariimo gaar ah oo magaaladaada ama astaanta Radar. Fariimaha hore ama la saaray waxaa laga yaabaa inaanay mar dambe soo muuqan.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Xisaabta ka tirtir app-ka: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Ama iimayl u dir {email}. Haddii aadan ku darin iimayl, app-ku wuxuu muujiyaa {deleteProfile}. Eeg bogga {page} tallaabooyinka.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Meel qaadis ma maqan tahay? App-ka taabo {suggest}. Mid ma qaldan yahay? Taabo {reportProblem}. Ama noo soo dir iimayl, waan hubinaynaa.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar kuma xirmo xisaabaadkaaga Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat ama app-yada gaarsiinta kale. Waligeen ma weydiino gelitaanka, erayada sirta ah, faahfaahinta xisaabta, xogta macmiilka ama faahfaahinta dalabka. Darawaladu waxay wadaagaan oo keliya warbixinada qaadista, sida wakhtiyada sugitaanka iyo dhibaatooyinka meelaha qaadista.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Tijaabi PickupRadar ka hor intaan app-ku bilaabmin.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Horudhaca tooska ah wuxuu muujiyaa meelo qaadis iyo sugitaan dhab ah oo Milton Keynes. Warbixinta iyo {radarPoints} waxay ku jiraan oo keliya app-ka mobaylka.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Cinwaankaas kuma jiro goobta PickupRadar. Bogaggani way jiraan:

legal.updated.text: Markii ugu dambeysay ee la cusbooneysiiyay: {date}

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: Soo koobidda iyo cinwaannada qaybaha waa la turjumay. Siyaasadda asturnaanta oo dhammaystiran waxay ku qoran tahay Ingiriisi, nuqulka Ingiriisiguna waa kan rasmiga ah.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy.h.collect.text: Macluumaadka aan ururino iyo sida aan u isticmaalno

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: PickupRadar waxay darawallada keenista ka caawisaa inay arkaan oo ka warbixiyaan waqtiyada sugitaanka qaadashada iyo dhibaatooyinka goobaha.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Waad daalacan kartaa adigoon akoon lahayn. Abka wuxuu taleefankaaga u sameeyaa astaan Radar oo qarsoodi ah, akoonka iimaylkuna waa ikhtiyaari.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Haddii aad oggolaato goobta, abku wuxuu isticmaalaa oo keliya inta aad isticmaalayso: si uu u habeeyo goobaha qaadashada ee kuu dhow, u ogaado magaaladaada, una hubiyo inaad joogto goobta marka aad dirayso warbixin toos ah. Goobtaada kuma kaydino warbixinnadaada.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Goobaha qaadashada ee aad kaydisay waxay ku jiraan taleefankaaga.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Ma iibinno macluumaadkaaga gaarka ah, abkuna ma laha raadiyeyaal xayeysiis ama falanqeyn.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Waxaad tirtiri kartaa astaantaada Radar ama akoonkaaga gudaha abka, ama iimayl nooga codso. Eeg {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Sida loo tirtiro akoonkaaga PickupRadar, astaanta Radar iyo xogta la xiriirta, xitaa abka la'aantiis.

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Boggan wuxuu sharxayaa sida loo tirtiro akoonkaaga PickupRadar, astaantaada Radar iyo xogta ku xiran, xitaa haddii aanad abka haysan. PickupRadar waxaa sameeyay Hamza Khan.

delete.app.title.text: Ku tirtir abka gudihiisa (tan ugu dhakhsaha badan)

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.
delete.app.step2.text: Taabo {profile} xagga hoose ee shaashadda hore.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Hoos u dhaadhac oo taabo {deleteAccount} haddii aad RadarPoints-kaaga ku sugtay iimayl, haddii kale {deleteProfile}.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Tirtirku isla markiiba wuu bilaabmaa. Kadib abku wuxuu taleefankaaga ka bilaabaa astaan Radar oo qarsoodi ah oo cusub.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Naga codso inaan tirtirno akoonkaaga iimaylka

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Haddii aad RadarPoints-kaaga ku sugtay ciwaan iimayl oo aadan isticmaali karin abka:

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: adigoo ka diraya ciwaanka iimaylka ee akoonkaaga PickupRadar

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Waxaan ku jawaabi doonnaa ciwaankaas si aan u xaqiijino codsiga ka hor intaanan waxba tirtirin.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Haddii aad ka qorto ciwaan kale, waxaan u baahan doonnaa inaan xaqiijino inaad maamusho ciwaanka iimaylka akoonka. Weligeen kuma weydiin doonno furaha sirta ah ama koodhka galitaanka. Ha noo soo dirin koodhkaaga.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Haddii aanad weligaa ku darin ciwaan iimayl, astaantaada Radar waxay ku xiran tahay oo keliya aqoonsi aan kala sooc lahayn oo ku kaydsan abka taleefankaaga. Habka ugu fudud ee loo tirtiro waa gudaha abka, adigoo raacaya tallaabooyinka kore.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Tirtiridda abka waxay aqoonsigaas ka saartaa taleefankaaga, laakiin {not} diiwaannada ku jira server-yadayada.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Lahaanshaha astaan qarsoodi ah waxaa lagu caddeyn karaa oo keliya taleefanka lagu sameeyay, iyadoo la isticmaalayo aqoonsiga aan kala soocnayn iyo koodhka sirta ah ee ku kaydsan abka. Faahfaahinta sida magaca Radar, magaalada ama taariikhaha aad isticmaashay abka ma caddeynayso in astaantu taada tahay, sababtoo ah dad kale ayaa laga yaabaa inay ogaadaan. Sidaas darteed, haddii aanad abka haysan, waxaa laga yaabaa inaanan tirtiri karin astaan qarsoodi ah. Weli waxaad iimayl u diri kartaa {email} waxaanan kuu sharxi doonnaa waxa aan qaban karno.

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Waxaad ka noqon kartaa ogeysiiska furitaanka gudaha abka, ama iimayl noogu soo dir ciwaanka aad isku diiwaangelisay, waxaanan tirtiri doonnaa diiwaangelinta ciwaankaas. Iimaylada ogeysiiska furitaanka si toos ah ayaa sidoo kale loo tirtiraa, sida ay sharaxayso {privacy} -ayadu.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Astaantaada Radar, magaca Radar, RadarPoints iyo taariikhda kaqaybgalka

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Galitaankaaga iimaylka, haddii aad lahayd akoon iimayl

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Qoraallada ku jira warbixinnada dhibaatada, warbixinnada xaaladda iyo soo jeedinta goobaha ee ku xiran astaantaada

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, sida waqtiyada sugitaanka, warbixinnada xaaladda iyo calaamadaha goobaha, iyo soo jeedinta goobaha: aqoonsiga qalabka ee diiwaannada ku xiran astaantaada waxaa lagu beddelaa qiime aan kala soocnayn, sidaas darteed xogtayada kuma xirna astaantaada mar dambe. Weli waxay leeyihiin faahfaahin sida goobta iyo waqtiga, sidaas darteed aqoonsiga waa laga saaray, laakiin gebi ahaanba qarsoodi ma aha. Waa la hayn karaa si ay u sii caawiyaan darawallada kale.

delete.kept.referrals.en: {lead} that involved you, without your profile.
delete.kept.referrals.text: {lead} aad ka qayb qaadatay, astaantaada la'aanteed.

delete.kept.receipt.en: {lead} for email accounts (an internal account reference, the device ID, a one-way scrambled copy of the phone’s secret code and dates), so the deletion can be completed safely and shown to have happened.
delete.kept.receipt.text: {lead} akoonnada iimaylka (tixraac gudaha ah oo akoonka, aqoonsiga qalabka, nuqul hal dhinac loo sir-qariyay oo koodhka sirta ah ee taleefanka, iyo taariikhaha), si tirtirka loo dhammaystiro si ammaan ah loona muujiyo inuu dhacay.

delete.kept.backups.en: {lead}: our database provider keeps daily backups for 7 days, so deleted information can stay in a backup for up to 7 days.
delete.kept.backups.text: {lead}: bixiyaha xogtayada wuxuu hayaa kayd maalinle ah 7 maalmood, sidaas darteed macluumaadka la tirtiray waxay ku jiri karaan kayd ilaa 7 maalmood.

delete.kept.support.en: {lead} about your request, for as long as we need them to deal with it.
delete.kept.support.text: {lead} ku saabsan codsigaaga, inta loogu baahan yahay in la xalliyo.

delete.kept.more.en: See our {privacy} for full details of how long we keep information and your other rights.
delete.kept.more.text: Faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan muddada aan haynno macluumaadka iyo xuquuqdaada kale, eeg {privacy} -ayada.
